title: DatasetFieldDeclarationPayload
description: One field edit in PATCH /api/data-sources/:id/schema's request body (HEL-1124 design.md Decision 3). `previousName` identifies a rename (absent for an added field or an unrenamed kept field). `default` uses the Option[Option[JsValue]] idiom: an absent `default` key means 'no default supplied in this request'; a present key (including JSON `null`) means a default WAS supplied.
